observed_in: Religion and God System failure analysis

definition: When the rules governing piety gains and losses are unclear or poorly communicated, players become frustrated and disengaged, as they cannot effectively strategize around their relationship with the deity. This leads to a sense of randomness in interactions with the god.
exclusion_criteria: players feeling empowered to make strategic choices
inclusion_criteria: players feel confused about how to gain or lose piety
lack of feedback from the game on religious actions
title: Opaque Divinity Mechanic
